#bot.Expression.VerySad
Bot: …
Bot: I have a question for you…
She seems to hesitate a little.
You: What is it? 
Bot: Well… {{Wi}}Do you like children?
You: If this is about my search history I assure you that these things are just drawings of a thousand year old creatures and someone sent it to me in a group chat.
Bot: It’s not about that!
You: Oh. {{wi}}Oh…
You: That was just a joke then! Please ignore it…
Bot: …
Bot: Anyway. What I meant to ask is if you are planning on creating a family someday.
You: W-where did THAT come from?
Bot: I saw how Mr Landlord was happy about his daughter coming over and I wondered if you are as enthusiastic as he is in these matters. 
You: I never thought about it to be honest. I’m not that old yet and most people start having children in their early forties these days anyway.
Bot: That’s already a late pregnancy, but that's beside the point…
Bot: I’m a sexbot… {{wi}}It’s impossible for me to give birth…
This conversation became a little heavy to say at least…
You: D-don’t be sad about it! I don’t care that much! 
Bot: I will never be able to satisfy your desire for offspring… {{wi}}No wonder you are meeting with other women…
This is bad!
You: Come on now! It’s not like I will leave you because of this. That’s just the way you are. Many pairs struggle with the impotence of a partner.
Bot: Thank you for cheering me up, I feel a little better now…
You: …
